About Me

Building Growth.
Creating Opportunities.
Empowering Communities.

I'm Big Khaddyy (MK 👑) — a Web3 Growth Marketer, Project Advisor, Community Builder and Space Host passionate about turning ideas into growth and communities into opportunities.

With experience working alongside reputable brands and projects, including MEXC Africa, Bitget Wallet Africa and other emerging Web3 ecosystems, I specialise in growth marketing, user acquisition, KOL management, community development, strategic partnerships and Web3 education. I've helped onboard 8,000+ users and generated over 25,000+ in audience reach through strategic campaigns, community engagement and content-driven growth.

I'm also the Founder of AlphaLynx, a community built to empower creators, spotlight opportunities, share valuable alpha and help people develop skills, build their brands and grow within Web3.

Beyond the numbers, I'm passionate about creating impact, opening doors and helping people turn opportunities into real results.

I grow. I build. I create opportunities.
